meta.title: ADHD-Friendly English Learning
meta.description: SYA's ADHD-Friendly English Learning respects each student's way and pace of learning. Students build speaking and conversation skills in 1:1 or small-group classes.

points: Lessons adapted to each student's characteristics

hero.title: ADHD-Friendly English Learning
hero.copy: Not one method for every student, but English learning that fits each student.
hero.description: Every student focuses and learns at a different pace. SYA considers each student's English level and individual learning characteristics to provide step-by-step English classes centered on real communication.

approach.title: Personalized English learning that considers each student

items.title: Individual learning goals
items.description: We set the direction of classes based on the student's English level and learning goals.

items.title: Step-by-step learning

items.title: Adjusting how we teach
items.description: We adjust explanations, activity length and feedback according to the student's responses and learning situation.

items.title: Positive feedback
items.description: We respect each student's effort and participation and give specific feedback.

audience.title: From children to teenagers
audience.description: We consult with families to find a suitable class format based on the student's age, English level and learning goals.
audience.note: We do not decide whether a student can join based on an ADHD diagnosis alone. The scope of educational support we can offer each student is confirmed during consultation.

process.title: How it works
steps: Understanding the student's English level and learning needs
Recommending a suitable class format and learning direction

items.question: What ages can join?
items.answer: The program is for children through teenagers. We recommend a suitable class format through consultation, based on the student's age, English level and learning goals.

items.question: Can we choose between 1:1 and small-group classes?
items.answer: We offer both class formats. During consultation, we recommend the format that suits the student, considering their learning characteristics, goals and your preferences.

items.question: Can a student who is new to English apply for a consultation?
items.answer: Yes. We first check the student's current English level and then suggest a class direction at the right level.

items.question: Can the teaching approach be adjusted to the student's learning characteristics?
items.answer: We adjust explanations, activity length and feedback according to the student's responses and learning situation. The specific support we can offer each student is confirmed together during consultation.

items.question: How can I check class schedules and fees?
items.answer: Class schedules, group size and fees have not yet been finalized and may vary by class format and duration. Details are provided during consultation.

cta.title: Find the right English class for your child.
cta.description: Tell us your child's age, English level, learning goals and preferred class format, and we will recommend a suitable learning direction.

page.disclaimer: ADHD-Friendly English Learning is an English education program, not a medical or therapeutic service. It does not provide diagnosis or treatment and does not guarantee any improvement in symptoms.

consultation.title: ADHD-Friendly English Learning Consultation
consultation.notice: This request will be received as an ADHD-Friendly English Learning inquiry. Please tell us the student's age, preferred class format, English level and learning goals.
consultation.goalPlaceholder: e.g. I'd like my child to practice speaking English with confidence.
consultation.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Let us know about the student's learning characteristics or anything we should keep in mind in class.
